blocks.text: New listings in Maple Ridge come on the MLS® every day. This search shows the ones that have been on the market 7 days or less, live. To judge a fresh listing, it helps to know how quickly the market is clearing: in October 2026, 59 detached homes and 46 condos and townhomes sold in Maple Ridge, and the typical detached home sold in 33 days.
How fast Maple Ridge homes sold over the past year

Detached sales in Maple Ridge peaked at 60 in July 2026 and were lowest at 30 in January 2026. Active detached listings moved between 313 and 452 over the same 13 months. In October 2026 the median detached sale price was $1,152,500, which is 4% below October 2025.

blocks.text: How long a new Maple Ridge listing may sit

Months of supply is the number of months it would take to sell today's listings at the current pace. For Maple Ridge detached homes it was 6.6 months in October 2026 and for condos and townhomes 5.8. The fastest detached price ranges were $800,001 to $900,000 (39% sales ratio on 11 sales); $1,000,001 to $1,250,000 (20% sales ratio on 21 sales); $900,001 to $1,000,000 (20% sales ratio on 9 sales). For condos and townhomes the quickest were $300,001 to $400,000 (28%) and $500,001 to $600,000 (24%).

By area, new detached listings met the strongest demand in Cottonwood (22%), Albion (20%), Southwest (19%). The areas with the most stock relative to sales were West Central (8%), Silver Valley (11%), Northwest (16%), so a fresh listing there is likely to have company.

Compared with October 2025, October 2026 had 14% fewer detached homes for sale in Maple Ridge and 16% more detached sales. Condos and townhomes had 9% fewer for sale and 6% fewer sales. The detached sale price moved 4% down and the condo and townhome price 12% down.
